[SWS_DM_00213]
DTC
status processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067
⌈
The DM shall process the
UDS DTC status byte
harmonizing with the ISO 14229-
1[1] standard.
⌋
ISO 14229-1 Annex D generally defines
UDS DTC status byte
handling and the
corresponding triggers for them. The following requirements map interfaces and con-
figuration parameters of the DM to generic
UDS DTC status bit
transition descrip-
tions.
